meta.name: render-logo-equation-card
meta.description: Render the logo-equation card ad (7s, 9:16) — partner icon + brand icon joined by a plus sign as an equation, a two-line "= outcome" headline, four numbered steps, and a CTA that hard-cuts in at 2s, on a static black card over timelapse b-roll, no voice. render_card.py draws the two card plates with measured geometry and hard guardrails (the user must confirm the integration is real, no partnership/endorsement/ranking words, no comment-bait CTA, no dashes); compose.py lays the card over the b-roll sped up to read as a timelapse, with an optional bed; measure_motion.py gates the b-roll (a real-time shot reads as a photo). Free, local.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入两张品牌图标,生成一版 7 秒竖屏广告卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要出联名或合作类的竖版短广告,又不想手动剪辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Turn two brand icons into a 7-second vertical ad card over timelapse b-roll
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick vertical ad card for a partner or co-branded launch without manual editing

howto.what: 它会用你提供的两个真实图标和文案，画出 7 秒竖版黑底卡片视频：图标相加、两行“= 结果”标题、四个步骤、CTA 在第 2 秒硬切，叠在加速成延时摄影的空镜上，无人声。
howto.when: 当你备好卡片文案（partner、headline、steps 等）和一段真实产品空镜，并确认合作集成确实存在时，它会开始渲染。

say.text: 按这份 card.json 渲染卡片，合作集成我确认真实
say.note: 输出无 CTA 与含 CTA 两张卡片图

say.text: 把卡片合成到 broll 上，用 4 倍速输出 ad.mp4
say.note: 卡片叠在加速成延时的空镜上

say.text: 用 measure_motion.py 检测 ad.mp4，CTA 在第 2 秒
say.note: 运动均值低于 1.5 直接判废

howto.what_en: It renders a 7s vertical 9:16 black-card ad: two real icons joined by a plus, a two-line '= outcome' headline, four steps, and a CTA cutting in at 2s over a sped-up b-roll timelapse. No voice; guardrails block unconfirmed or off-rule copy.
howto.when_en: Use it when you have card copy (partner, headline, steps, cta) plus real product footage, and you confirm the integration truly exists. measure_motion.py rejects b-roll that is too static.

say_en.text: Render the card from this card.json; I confirmed the integration is real
Compose the cards over broll.mp4 at 4x speed into ad.mp4
say_en.note: Card sits atop the timelapse b-roll

say_en.text: Run measure_motion.py on ad.mp4 with the CTA at 2.0s
